confirmed_facts: The run belongs to the distinct task key arc-bench-lite-evolution--keep; the older arc-bench-lite--keep mapping is not part of this diagnosis.
The authoritative platform result is FAILED, 2/6, score 33.3; REQ-8.2 and REQ-9.2 passed while REQ-7.1, REQ-7.2, REQ-8.1 and REQ-9.1 timed out.
REQ-7.1 and REQ-7.2 both fail at clickNamed/helpers.ts:123 with Target page, context or browser has been closed.
REQ-8.1 waits for Passport inside the Packing checklist card and the element is not found within the 10 second test timeout.
REQ-9.1 waits for a visible Groceries note card and the element is not found within the 10 second test timeout.
The final template db.json contains seed-2 Groceries with an empty collaborators array and a seeded Packing checklist containing Passport and Charger.

The generated frontend replaces the static cards with /api/notes results in loadNotes(), while wireExistingCards() separately binds the initial static DOM; the evidence does not include a trace proving which state won at each failure.

Internal implement acceptance is a separate layer: REQ-8.2 timed out in the 900 second generation turn even though platform REQ-8.2 passed in 785 ms.

failure_chain.observed_failure: Target page, context or browser has been closed while clickNamed resolves/clicks a control.
failure_chain.diagnosis: The failure is a browser/page lifecycle interruption, not an element-locator miss. The supplied artifacts do not identify whether the close was initiated by the test, browser, frontend, or backend process.

failure_chain.observed_failure: Passport is not visible in the Packing checklist card.
failure_chain.diagnosis: The final package has the checklist data model and a seeded checklist, but the persisted run database also contains a later Packing checklist with an empty checklist. This confirms a state/payload discrepancy; the exact point where checklist items were lost remains unproven.

failure_chain.observed_failure: The Groceries card is not visible before collaborator interaction.
failure_chain.diagnosis: The final database retains seed-2 Groceries, so the failure is not explained by a missing seed record alone. A client load/render race, stale DOM replacement, or an earlier lifecycle interruption remains possible; no trace isolates one cause.

root_cause_candidates.issue: Frontend/browser lifecycle race or process interruption
evidence: REQ-7.1 and REQ-7.2 share the page-closed signature
raw logs contain BrokenPipe and browser/process cleanup evidence
the final report has no backend stack trace or browser trace proving the initiator
root_cause_candidates.minimal_fix_hypothesis: Capture browser/video/trace and server lifecycle logs in a clean reproduction; then make the smallest lifecycle or request-error fix supported by that trace.

root_cause_candidates.issue: Checklist editor payload or post-save state loses checklist items
evidence: a later Packing checklist record has checklist: []
root_cause_candidates.minimal_fix_hypothesis: Trace the editor checklist rows through collectEditorChecklist(), POST/PUT payload, response, and the subsequent loadNotes() replacement; ensure the server response and rendered card preserve the submitted items.

root_cause_candidates.issue: Initial static DOM and API-backed rendering are not observed as one deterministic state
evidence: index.html ships static Groceries and Packing checklist cards
app.js binds static cards and then asynchronously replaces containers from /api/notes
REQ-9.1 cannot see Groceries although seed-2 remains in db.json
root_cause_candidates.minimal_fix_hypothesis: Use one authoritative initial render path and instrument the API response/render completion before interaction tests start; verify no stale replacement removes seeded cards.

excluded_causes: Not an entrypoint failure: main.py completed and the generated application was reached.
Not a bundled-test fallback: /workspace/tests was used and bundled fallback hits were zero.
Not a blanket platform outage: REQ-8.2 and REQ-9.2 passed in the same final Playwright run.
Not an API-key disclosure finding: the supplied evidence reports no plaintext key.
The internal REQ-8.2 generation timeout cannot be used as the platform cause because platform REQ-8.2 passed.
evidence_gaps: No browser trace, video, HAR, or platform-native error-context bodies were supplied for the page-closed failures.
No bound build/commit/upload ZIP SHA or task snapshot ID links the platform execution to a source revision.
The supplied artifacts do not record the exact POST/PUT request payload that produced the empty checklist record.
The supplied artifacts do not establish whether the Groceries failure occurred before API load, during DOM replacement, or after a prior page interruption.
